digest.component_or_area: Backend port transport wiring in reconcile core
propositions: The backend-neutral core still names Jira concretely by constructing an AcliClient inline instead of using the Backend port.
The four transport/construction sites are routed through select_backend(load_config()).transport so the core stops building AcliClient inline.
The two provider-identity 'jira' literals in apply_inbound_records.py are replaced by the selected backend's vendor, retaining only the validate_creation_channel('jira') vocabulary key.
apply_handlers.py catches AssigneeNotFoundError via a direct import rather than through ctx.acli.
A neutrality gate test asserts no direct AcliClient( construction remains in the transport modules while the full reconcile suite stays green.
Routing core importer sites off vendor mappers via injection and single-sourcing ADF-sizing, value-maps, and link constants under adapters/jira/ are split to a follow-up.
